title: Resolution marking November 25 against violence toward women
summary: This resolution declares November 25 as the International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women in New York City, honoring the Mirabal sisters. It cites 2025 data showing women make up 57.4% of domestic violence homicide victims citywide, with Black women disproportionately affected at 33.7% of intimate partner homicides. The measure is symbolic and does not create new programs or funding.
